"""Repro for ticket #13964: saving parent after setting child pk loses FK value."""
import django
from django.conf import settings

settings.configure(
    DEBUG=True,
    DATABASES={'default': {'ENGINE': 'django.db.backends.sqlite3', 'NAME': ':memory:'}},
    INSTALLED_APPS=['django.contrib.contenttypes', 'django.contrib.auth'],
    DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD='django.db.models.AutoField',
    USE_TZ=True,
)
django.setup()

from django.db import models, transaction, connection


class Product(models.Model):
    sku = models.CharField(primary_key=True, max_length=50)

    class Meta:
        app_label = 'repro'


class Order(models.Model):
    product = models.ForeignKey(Product, on_delete=models.CASCADE)

    class Meta:
        app_label = 'repro'


class Category(models.Model):
    pass  # auto (numeric) pk — control case

    class Meta:
        app_label = 'repro'


class Item(models.Model):
    category = models.ForeignKey(Category, on_delete=models.CASCADE)

    class Meta:
        app_label = 'repro'


with connection.schema_editor() as se:
    se.create_model(Product)
    se.create_model(Order)
    se.create_model(Category)
    se.create_model(Item)

from django.db.utils import IntegrityError  # noqa: E402

print('=== Case A: non-numeric pk, set AFTER assignment (the bug) ===')
try:
    with transaction.atomic():
        order = Order()
        order.product = Product()
        order.product.sku = 'foo'
        order.product.save()
        order.save()
        print('stored product_id:', list(Order.objects.values_list('product_id', flat=True)))
        print('filter(product=order.product).exists():',
              Order.objects.filter(product=order.product).exists())
except IntegrityError as e:
    print('IntegrityError on commit:', e)

print('=== Case B: non-numeric pk, set BEFORE assignment (works) ===')
with transaction.atomic():
    order = Order()
    order.product = Product(sku='bar')
    order.product.save()
    order.save()
    print('stored product_id:', list(Order.objects.values_list('product_id', flat=True)))
    print('filter(product=order.product).exists():',
          Order.objects.filter(product=order.product).exists())

print('=== Case C: numeric (auto) pk, set AFTER assignment (control) ===')
try:
    with transaction.atomic():
        item = Item()
        item.category = Category()
        item.category.save()
        item.save()
        print('stored category_id:', list(Item.objects.values_list('category_id', flat=True)))
        print('filter(category=item.category).exists():',
              Item.objects.filter(category=item.category).exists())
except IntegrityError as e:
    print('IntegrityError:', e)
